style_base: Simple crude hand-drawn cartoon in the style of the 'Ecomonos' youtube channel. A recurring brown cartoon monkey character with big round white eyes and black pupils, thick bold black outlines, flat colors, expressive exaggerated faces - but in a DARK HACKER setting: dark near-black navy background, moody lighting, glowing green terminal-code and subtle red accents lighting the scene, the monkey often wearing a dark grey hoodie. Comedy-meets-noir tone. The SAME monkey character appears consistently in every image. CRITICAL TEXT RULE: prefer NO text, labels or signs at all - tell the scene through the monkey's action and expression and simple symbols. If a short text is truly necessary it MUST be in perfect SPANISH exactly as specified, in large simple block letters - NEVER English.
note: Mono rojo (Red Team) vs mono azul (Blue Team), estilo EXACTO tecno, fondos variados (SOC, oficina, arena).

frames.text: Cada gran empresa del mundo libra una guerra silenciosa todos los días.
frames.scene: a dark office building at night, two glowing silhouettes facing each other on opposite rooftops, one red-tinted, one blue-tinted, no text

frames.text: No sale en las noticias,
frames.scene: a wide shot of a corporate office building, calm exterior, no visible drama, no text

frames.text: no hay explosiones,
frames.scene: the same office building, completely quiet, no explosions, ironic calm, no text

frames.text: pero hay un equipo que ataca y otro que defiende,
frames.scene: a hooded monkey hacker wearing a red-tinted hoodie (Red Team) and a hooded monkey hacker wearing a blue-tinted hoodie (Blue Team) standing back to back inside the same office building, no text

frames.text: contra el mismo objetivo,
frames.scene: a hooded monkey hacker wearing a red-tinted hoodie (Red Team) and a hooded monkey hacker wearing a blue-tinted hoodie (Blue Team) both pointing at the same glowing company logo on a wall, no text

frames.text: la misma empresa.
frames.scene: a glowing company logo shield floating between the red and blue monkeys, no text

frames.text: Se llaman Red Team y Blue Team,
frames.scene: large glowing text-free banner split red and blue down the middle, no text

frames.text: y la pregunta que nadie responde bien es esta.
frames.scene: both monkeys turning to face the camera, a glowing question mark between them, no text

frames.text: ¿Quién gana de verdad?
frames.scene: a glowing golden trophy hovering between the red and blue monkey, contested, no text

frames.text: Capítulo 1.
frames.scene: a large glowing green chapter number '1' floating in darkness, no other text

frames.text: ¿Quién es el Red Team?
frames.scene: big green Spanish caption '¿QUIÉN ES EL RED TEAM?' over a dark office background, no other text

frames.text: El Red Team es el equipo que ataca su propia empresa, con permiso, para encontrar el fallo antes que un criminal real.
frames.scene: a hooded monkey hacker wearing a red-tinted hoodie (Red Team) climbing through a glowing wireframe network diagram of an office building, no text

frames.text: Pienzan como un atacante todo el tiempo, es su trabajo.
frames.scene: a hooded monkey hacker wearing a red-tinted hoodie (Red Team) sitting at a desk full of monitors, deep in thought, red glow, no text

frames.text: Un lunes cualquiera prueban si pueden entrar en la red interna desde fuera.
frames.scene: a hooded monkey hacker wearing a red-tinted hoodie (Red Team) sending a glowing phishing envelope toward a small office building icon, Monday calendar page, no text

frames.text: Un martes prueban si un empleado hace clic en un correo falso.
frames.scene: a hooded monkey hacker wearing a red-tinted hoodie (Red Team) sending a glowing phishing envelope toward a tiny employee avatar, Tuesday calendar page, no text

frames.text: Un miércoles prueban si pueden moverse de un ordenador a otro sin que nadie se de cuenta.
frames.scene: a hooded monkey hacker wearing a red-tinted hoodie (Red Team) sneaking silently between two glowing computer icons, Wednesday calendar page, no text

frames.text: Su herramienta favorita no es un virus de película,
frames.scene: a hooded monkey hacker wearing a red-tinted hoodie (Red Team) holding up an empty movie-style virus icon, crossed out, no text

frames.text: es la paciencia.
frames.scene: a hooded monkey hacker wearing a red-tinted hoodie (Red Team) instead holding a glowing hourglass, patience as the real weapon, no text

frames.text: Usan escáneres de vulnerabilidades, credenciales filtradas y mucho conocimiento del sistema operativo por dentro.
frames.scene: a glowing vulnerability scanner interface and a stream of leaked credential icons around a hooded monkey hacker wearing a red-tinted hoodie (Red Team), no text

frames.text: Si consiguen llegar hasta el controlador de dominio, han ganado esa ronda.
frames.scene: a hooded monkey hacker wearing a red-tinted hoodie (Red Team) reaching a glowing crown icon labeled as the top of a server hierarchy, victorious pose, no text

frames.text: Pero su objetivo nunca es destruir nada,
frames.scene: a hooded monkey hacker wearing a red-tinted hoodie (Red Team) standing calmly instead of destroying anything, hand raised in restraint, no text

frames.text: es escribir el informe que evita el desastre real.
frames.scene: a hooded monkey hacker wearing a red-tinted hoodie (Red Team) writing a thick glowing report document at a desk, red glow dimming to a calmer tone, no text

frames.text: Capítulo 2. ¿Quién es el Blue Team?
frames.scene: a large glowing green chapter number '2' floating in darkness, no other text

frames.text: El Blue Team es el equipo que defiende esa misma empresa todos los días, contra todo el mundo.
frames.scene: big green Spanish caption '¿QUIÉN ES EL BLUE TEAM?' over a dark SOC room background, no other text

frames.text: No sabe cuando llega el ataque,
frames.scene: a hooded monkey hacker wearing a blue-tinted hoodie (Blue Team) sitting in a glowing security operations center full of monitors, blue light everywhere, no text

frames.text: ni si es un simulacro del red team o un criminal de verdad.
frames.scene: a hooded monkey hacker wearing a blue-tinted hoodie (Blue Team) looking nervously at an unmarked glowing alert on a wall of screens, no text

frames.text: Vigila el tráfico de la red las 24 horas,
frames.scene: a hooded monkey hacker wearing a blue-tinted hoodie (Blue Team) looking at two identical alerts, one labeled drill, one blank, unable to tell them apart, no text

frames.text: revisa alertas,
frames.scene: a hooded monkey hacker wearing a blue-tinted hoodie (Blue Team) watching a glowing 24-hour clock spinning around a network traffic map, no text

frames.text: miles de alertas al día, la mayoría falsas.
frames.scene: a hooded monkey hacker wearing a blue-tinted hoodie (Blue Team) surrounded by a wall of glowing alert icons, no text

frames.text: Su trabajo es encontrar la aguja real en un pajar de ruido.
frames.scene: thousands of tiny glowing alert icons around a hooded monkey hacker wearing a blue-tinted hoodie (Blue Team), most fading out as false alarms, no text

frames.text: Cuando ocurre algo raro, tienen minutos, no horas, para decidir si es un ataque real.
frames.scene: a hooded monkey hacker wearing a blue-tinted hoodie (Blue Team) spotting a single glowing needle inside a giant haystack of alert icons, no text

frames.text: Usan sistemas de detección,
frames.scene: a glowing clock ticking fast next to a hooded monkey hacker wearing a blue-tinted hoodie (Blue Team), minutes counting down, tense, no text

frames.text: registros de actividad y una regla de oro. Nunca confiar por defecto.
frames.scene: a hooded monkey hacker wearing a blue-tinted hoodie (Blue Team) operating a glowing intrusion detection dashboard, blue SOC room, no text

frames.text: Si el red team consigue entrar sin que el Blue Team lo detecte, esa ronda la pierde en ellos.
frames.scene: a hooded monkey hacker wearing a blue-tinted hoodie (Blue Team) standing firm behind a glowing shield reading a golden rule symbol, no text

frames.text: Pero si lo detectan a tiempo, han hecho su trabajo perfectamente, aunque nadie fuera lo sepa nunca.
frames.scene: a hooded monkey hacker wearing a red-tinted hoodie (Red Team) slipping past a distracted a hooded monkey hacker wearing a blue-tinted hoodie (Blue Team) in the same SOC room, red team wins this round, no text

frames.text: Capítulo 3.
frames.scene: a hooded monkey hacker wearing a blue-tinted hoodie (Blue Team) catching a hooded monkey hacker wearing a red-tinted hoodie (Red Team) right on time, a glowing green checkmark appearing, blue team wins this round, no text

frames.text: La simulación que lo cambia todo.
frames.scene: a large glowing green chapter number '3' floating in darkness, no other text

frames.text: Muchas empresas ya no separan los dos equipos del todo,
frames.scene: big green Spanish caption 'LA SIMULACIÓN QUE LO CAMBIA TODO' over a dark background, no other text

frames.text: crean un parpe el team,
frames.scene: a hooded monkey hacker wearing a red-tinted hoodie (Red Team) and a hooded monkey hacker wearing a blue-tinted hoodie (Blue Team) standing on opposite sides of a glowing dividing wall inside an office, no text

frames.text: la mezcla de los dos, compartiendo lo que aprenden en cada simulacro.
frames.scene: the dividing wall between a hooded monkey hacker wearing a red-tinted hoodie (Red Team) and a hooded monkey hacker wearing a blue-tinted hoodie (Blue Team) cracking and merging into a purple glow, no text

frames.text: El red team ataca, el Blue Team defiende y luego se sientan juntos a revisar qué pasó.
frames.scene: a hooded monkey hacker wearing a red-tinted hoodie (Red Team) and a hooded monkey hacker wearing a blue-tinted hoodie (Blue Team) now sitting together at the same table, purple light mixing red and blue, no text

frames.text: Eso, más que la victoria de un solo vando,
frames.scene: a hooded monkey hacker wearing a red-tinted hoodie (Red Team) attacking a glowing network map while a hooded monkey hacker wearing a blue-tinted hoodie (Blue Team) watches and takes notes beside them, no text

frames.text: es lo que de verdad protege la empresa.
frames.scene: a hooded monkey hacker wearing a red-tinted hoodie (Red Team) and a hooded monkey hacker wearing a blue-tinted hoodie (Blue Team) reviewing a glowing report together, purple light, collaborative, no text

frames.text: Sin esa mezcla, el red team gana simulacros, pero la empresa sigue expuesta al ataque real.
frames.scene: a glowing shield protecting an office building, powered equally by red and blue light, no text

frames.text: Capítulo 4.
frames.scene: the dividing wall reappearing between a hooded monkey hacker wearing a red-tinted hoodie (Red Team) and a hooded monkey hacker wearing a blue-tinted hoodie (Blue Team), the office building left exposed and dim, no text

frames.text: El día a día real.
frames.scene: a large glowing green chapter number '4' floating in darkness, no other text

frames.text: Un red teamer pasa la mayor parte del tiempo investigando antes de atacar nada. Busca en redes sociales de empleados, en filtraciones antiguas, en la configuración pública de la empresa.
frames.scene: big green Spanish caption 'EL DÍA A DÍA REAL' over a dark background, no other text

frames.text: El ataque en sí puede durar minutos,
frames.scene: a hooded monkey hacker wearing a red-tinted hoodie (Red Team) scrolling through glowing social media profiles and old data-leak archives on a big screen, no text

frames.text: la investigación previa semanas.
frames.scene: a hooded monkey hacker wearing a red-tinted hoodie (Red Team) standing in front of a giant glowing wall of company public records, tiny among the data, no text

frames.text: Un Blue Teamer pasa la mayor parte del tiempo mirando paneles,
frames.scene: a glowing stopwatch showing minutes next to a hooded monkey hacker wearing a red-tinted hoodie (Red Team)'s attack, and weeks next to their research pile, no text

frames.text: no persiguiendo hackers de película.
frames.scene: a hooded monkey hacker wearing a blue-tinted hoodie (Blue Team) staring at rows of calm glowing dashboard panels, unglamorous SOC room, no text

frames.text: Configura alertas, ajustas reglas,
frames.scene: a hooded monkey hacker wearing a blue-tinted hoodie (Blue Team) yawning slightly at a quiet dashboard, no dramatic chase in sight, no text

frames.text: reduce el ruido para que la señal real se vea.
frames.scene: a hooded monkey hacker wearing a blue-tinted hoodie (Blue Team) adjusting glowing alert-threshold sliders on a control panel, no text

frames.text: El trabajo bonito de las series es apenas el 5 % de lo que hacen los dos equipos.
frames.scene: a hooded monkey hacker wearing a blue-tinted hoodie (Blue Team) turning down the noise level on a glowing dashboard until only a clear signal remains, no text

frames.text: Capítulo 5.
frames.scene: a tiny glowing movie-camera icon crossed out above both a hooded monkey hacker wearing a red-tinted hoodie (Red Team) and a hooded monkey hacker wearing a blue-tinted hoodie (Blue Team), real work is different, no text

frames.text: El dinero.
frames.scene: a large glowing green chapter number '5' floating in darkness, no other text

frames.text: ¿Y quién cobra más?
frames.scene: big green Spanish caption 'EL DINERO' over a dark background, no other text

frames.text: Aquí la respuesta sorprende a mucha gente.
frames.scene: a hooded monkey hacker wearing a red-tinted hoodie (Red Team) and a hooded monkey hacker wearing a blue-tinted hoodie (Blue Team) standing beside two glowing coin piles, one slightly taller, no text

frames.text: Una analista de Blue Team Junior en España empieza cerca de 28 .000 euros al año.
frames.scene: a glowing salary bar chart labeled with a euro symbol next to a hooded monkey hacker wearing a blue-tinted hoodie (Blue Team), big green Spanish caption '28.000 €'

frames.text: Un red teamer junior cerca de 32 .000, un poco más por el perfil ofensivo.
frames.scene: a slightly taller glowing salary bar chart next to a hooded monkey hacker wearing a red-tinted hoodie (Red Team), big green Spanish caption '32.000 €'

frames.text: Pero con experiencia,
frames.scene: the two salary bars growing closer in height over time, years passing on a calendar, no text

frames.text: la brecha se cierra casi del todo.
frames.scene: the two bars now almost equal height, senior versions of a hooded monkey hacker wearing a red-tinted hoodie (Red Team) and a hooded monkey hacker wearing a blue-tinted hoodie (Blue Team) standing taller, no text

frames.text: Un responsable de seguridad defensiva senior puede superar los 80 .000 euros al año en empresas grandes. Y el red team con más demanda ahora mismo no es el que ataca sistemas.
frames.scene: a very tall glowing salary bar chart above a senior a hooded monkey hacker wearing a blue-tinted hoodie (Blue Team), big green Spanish caption '80.000 €'

frames.text: Es el que simula ataques con inteligencia artificial contra la propia inteligencia artificial de la empresa.
frames.scene: a hooded monkey hacker wearing a red-tinted hoodie (Red Team) now facing a glowing artificial-intelligence brain icon instead of a normal computer, new frontier, no text

frames.text: Capítulo 6.
frames.scene: a hooded monkey hacker wearing a red-tinted hoodie (Red Team) simulating an attack against a glowing AI brain icon guarded by another glowing AI shield, no text

frames.text: Entonces,
frames.scene: a large glowing green chapter number '6' floating in darkness, no other text

frames.text: ¿Quién gana de verdad?
frames.scene: big green Spanish caption '¿QUIÉN GANA DE VERDAD?' over a dark background, no other text

frames.text: En una simulación aislada casi siempre gana el red team.
frames.scene: an isolated glowing arena with only a hooded monkey hacker wearing a red-tinted hoodie (Red Team) and a hooded monkey hacker wearing a blue-tinted hoodie (Blue Team) facing off, a hooded monkey hacker wearing a red-tinted hoodie (Red Team) winning this staged round, no text

frames.text: Atacar es más fácil que defenderlo todo, todo el tiempo.
frames.scene: a hooded monkey hacker wearing a red-tinted hoodie (Red Team) standing over a fallen glowing shield, attacking is easier than defending everything, no text

frames.text: Pero en la vida real,
frames.scene: the arena walls dissolving to reveal an entire glowing office building around them, real life is bigger, no text

frames.text: la empresa entera es el verdadero equipo. Si red team y Blue Team no comparten lo que aprenden, los dos pierden tarde o temprano.
frames.scene: the whole company glowing as one giant shield shape made of many small employee icons, no text

frames.text: Las empresas con mejor seguridad del mundo no son las que tienen el mejor atacante.
frames.scene: a hooded monkey hacker wearing a red-tinted hoodie (Red Team) and a hooded monkey hacker wearing a blue-tinted hoodie (Blue Team) standing apart with a crack between them, both slowly losing light over time, no text

frames.text: Son las que consiguen que ataca y defensa hablen entre ellos cada semana.
frames.scene: a glowing trophy labeled 'MEJOR SEGURIDAD' held up not by a hooded monkey hacker wearing a red-tinted hoodie (Red Team) alone, but by the whole shield, no text

frames.text: Así que la pregunta real no es quién gana.
frames.scene: a hooded monkey hacker wearing a red-tinted hoodie (Red Team) and a hooded monkey hacker wearing a blue-tinted hoodie (Blue Team) finally shaking paws in front of the whole glowing shield, weekly meeting, no text

frames.text: Es si tu empresa deja que los dos equipos se hablen.
frames.scene: the office building glowing warmly, question mark fading, a calm green checkmark appearing instead, no text

frames.text: Si te ha interesado este mundo, suscríbete. Se viene mucho más sobre ciberseguridad real, contada sin humo.
frames.scene: a hooded monkey hacker wearing a red-tinted hoodie (Red Team) and a hooded monkey hacker wearing a blue-tinted hoodie (Blue Team) standing together looking at the camera, purple light, big green Spanish caption 'SUSCRÍBETE'
